description: Price and lock an exact room for specific dates. Returns the live price, cancellation policy, and a secure booking link with the room preselected. Requires connecting your Roomza account.
name: secure_room

acpItemId.description: Item id for an Agentic Commerce Protocol checkout of this stay, when Roomza can take payment in the chat

bookable.description: true when a live bookable rate was found

bookingUrl.description: Secure checkout link with the room preselected; payment happens only there

checkout.description: Where the booking link finishes: Roomza's checkout or the hotel's own website

currency.description: ISO 4217 currency of every amount below

dueAtHotel.description: Additional amount due at the hotel, in currency units

included.description: true: inside the total; false: due at the hotel

freeCancelUntil.description: YYYY-MM-DD free-cancellation deadline, for refundable rates

indicativeOnly.description: true when the price is from public listings, not bookable

merchant.description: Who charges the guest: the supplier, Roomza, or the hotel itself

ok.description: false = the request could not be quoted; see message

priceCheckedAt.description: When this price was read; prices are live until booked, and checkout never charges more than the price shown

publicRate.description: Hotel's public rate, in currency units, for comparison

taxesIncluded.description: Taxes and fees inside the total, in currency units

totalToday.description: Total price of the stay, in currency units; when it is charged is shown at checkout

title: Price and lock a room
